overview: Cuthbert Burbage called from Holywell. His father had walked the playhouse half the night with a lantern. Two hired men are to sleep in the tiring-house from tonight at sixpence each, and the yard gates are to be chained after the play. Cuthbert would have had the flag down on a trouble day, since a white swan is a thing to throw at. You said keep it up, because a house that hides looks guilty. He said that was his father's opinion. You said it was Heminges's first. He called it three to one.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Said the house should not hide, and named Heminges as the first of the three.

parties.name: Cuthbert Burbage
parties.context: Called from Holywell, set the two men at sixpence and the chain after the play, and yielded on the flag.

parties.name: James Burbage
parties.context: Walked the playhouse with a lantern. He was not on the call. His son reported him.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Not on the call. You said the flag had been his opinion first.
